definitions.explanation: A state free from disturbance, conflict, or anxiety. Describes a quiet, uneventful, and stable condition of life, society, or nature.

examples.japanese: {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{平穏|へいおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。

⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わり、⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ようやく{平穏|へいおん}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After years of conflict ended, the people were finally able to reclaim a peaceful life.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or formal word. More elevated in register than ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ (quiet) or ⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧ (calm). Often used in news reports and written descriptions of social conditions. {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (peaceful life) and {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧ (peaceful days) are very common phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: peaceful days
- {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: peaceful life
- {平穏|へいおん}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: tranquil living
- {平穏|へいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain peace
- {平穏|へいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧: to restore peace
- {平穏|へいおん}⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧: safe and peaceful
